)

       avg_price.average_product_price

JOIN avg_price ON s.supplier_id = avg_price.supplier_id

questions.nlq: Could you help me determine which product categories demonstrate exceptional supplier diversity based on our procurement records, including the category type, number of unique suppliers involved, and their combined purchase values?
evidence: 'Exceptional supplier diversity' is defined as products supplied by at least 4 different suppliers where each supplier's average total_value_purchased across all their supplied products exceeds $15,000. This metric measures both supplier concentration and the economic significance of each supplier relationship.

Product types are categorized according to the following business classification standards: 'Clothes' includes all apparel items, 'Electronics' covers consumer devices, 'Furniture' encompasses home furnishings, and 'Gourmet' contains specialty food items. WITH QualifiedSuppliers AS (
    SELECT supplier_id
    FROM Product_Suppliers
    GROUP BY supplier_id
    HAVING AVG(CAST(total_value_purchased AS REAL)) > 15000
),
DiverseProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_type_code
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
    INNER JOIN QualifiedSuppliers qs ON ps.supplier_id = qs.supplier_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_type_code
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.supplier_id) >= 4
)
SELECT 
    dp.product_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.supplier_id) AS num_unique_suppliers,
    SUM(ps.total_value_purchased) AS combined_purchase_values
FROM DiverseProducts dp
INNER JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON dp.product_id = ps.product_id
INNER JOIN QualifiedSuppliers qs ON ps.supplier_id = qs.supplier_id
GROUP BY dp.product_type_code
